svg.aria-label: ESP32-DevKitC V4 pinout with safe, careful and avoid pins
svg.text: ESP32-DevKitC V4 pinout (top view, USB at the bottom)
Left header J2 and right header J3, 19 pins each at 2.54 mm; pin numbers inside the board edge

g.text: ◆ = pin used in this course. ADC2 pins (ADC2_n) cannot read analog while Wi-Fi is on; use ADC1.
strap: must be low at boot

svg.text: GPIO16/17 are free on WROOM boards only. "Strap" pins set the boot mode at reset; see the boot-mode drawing.
